text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both modestly up over 24 hours, with Ethereum slightly outpacing Bitcoin, suggesting steady interest across the two largest assets rather than concentrated strength in one. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 61 but declined 4 points over the week, indicating sentiment remains positive yet cooling slightly from recent peaks. Bitcoin's 59.6% dominance and robust $441B daily volume reflect a healthy, liquid market without extreme concentration risk.
